Name: Fizzy Drinks
Author: MelindaC
Description:
[size=5]Regarding 1.6 Part 2:[/size]

[font=Tahoma][size=3]For those wondering whether Fizzy Drinks is 1.6 compliant, sadly that's not the case. As of 4/4, this mod is officially retired.

[/size][/font][size=3]F[font=Tahoma]izzy Drinks was intended to be an offshoot of [url=https://nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5173]Artisanal Soda Makers[/url] but so far there's been word on any updates. I have sent an inquiry to Hadi (hadiwrites42) but so far no response.

Fizzy Drinks was heavily dependent on PPJA, especially [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1926]Artisan Valley[/url]. If you read the description, then you'd get the notice saying that it's no longer being maintained after 1.6. So far, there's been no mod (though there's a few in development) that can replace the swath of resources that Artisan Valley and its fellow PPJA mods brought to this mod.

Last but not certainly least, is that my modding partner Fwippy (maerumaer2u) had quit after four years making assets for Fizzy Drinks. A catastrophic hard drive failure wiped out all of her files including all the assets from her mods she was working on and obviously can't work without a computer. This has literally devastated her to the point she's quitting Stardew Valley altogether. The only good news is that she had given me the full rights to the assets that she already made.

After many tears later, I decided I had no choice but to retire this mod and start anew. I am hoping to work on a new modding project called "Melinda's Teas, Trees and Bushes" that will use at least some of the assets from Fizzy Drinks and also taking advantage of the new [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20619]Custom Bush[/url] mod for my lovely tea bushes that I can fully implement. In addition I am hoping to integrate [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15963]More Wild Berries[/url] into 1.6 now that Bush Bloom Mod is now 1.6 compliant but without the Artisanal Soda Makers aspect.

Once again, thanks for all the support over the last four years. I learned a lot about modding and coding and am now going to do this on my own. Please note that any general inquiries regarding Fizzy Drinks are still welcome. Take care now!﻿﻿﻿
[/font][/size][size=3]
